day_context_interpretation_rule: allowed_day_contexts are possibility windows, not generated transactions. The transaction generator must select only a realistic subset within monthly_occurrence_budgets. If two allowed contexts represent the same underlying need, generate at most one transaction or posting path for that need.
candidate_window_selection_rule: When multiple days are marked as candidates for the same monthly-capped behavior, the transaction generator must respect the monthly cap. Candidate days are alternatives, not instructions to generate on every listed day.
simpl_date_rule: New June Simpl usage may only be generated on 2025-06-23, 2025-06-24, 2025-06-25, 2025-06-26, 2025-06-27, 2025-06-28, or 2025-06-29. 2025-06-30 salary day must not create new Simpl usage.
salary_end_rail_selection_rule: On salary-end candidate days, Simpl is only one possible rail for selected food/quick-commerce needs. The transaction generator must choose one rail per underlying need: Simpl, Axis card, or UPI. It must not create parallel Simpl and card/UPI postings for the same meal, grocery, or late-work food need.
